patch_description: This edit refactors the `ANSATZ_SPEC` to use parameter sharing and replaces the CRY gates with CRZ gates, as recommended. Specifically, I have consolidated the single-qubit rotations (RY and RZ) into pair-wise shared parameters to reduce the parameter count, which has been shown in previous iterations to improve efficiency and generalization. I have also replaced the CRY gates with CRZ gates and cleaned up redundant RZ layers, resulting in a more streamlined and performant circuit architecture.
